question: Bratislava je jediné hlavné mesto na svete, ktoré hraničí priamo s dvoma inými štátmi. S ktorými?
source_excerpt: the only national capital to have land borders with two other sovereign states

extra.why_interesting: Slovaks know Bratislava sits at the edge of the country, but few realise this makes it unique among all world capitals. A player can work out both neighbours by picturing the map.
extra.verification_notes: Wikipedia confirms Bratislava is the only national capital bordering two other sovereign states, Austria and Hungary (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bratislava).

explanation: Z Petržalky sa dá dôjsť pešo do Rakúska aj do Maďarska. Žiadna iná metropola sveta nestojí hneď pri dvoch cudzích štátoch.

question: Pravda alebo nepravda: Najdlhšiu spoločnú hranicu má Slovensko s Poľskom.
source_excerpt: Total 1,611 km: Austria 105 km, Czech Republic 241 km, Hungary 679 km, Poland 541 km, Ukraine 98 km

extra.why_interesting: The long, mountainous northern border with Poland feels huge, and the shared history with Czechia feels closest. But the southern border along the Danube and the Ipeľ is the longest.
extra.verification_notes: Slovakia's longest border is with Hungary (~679 km), longer than Poland's (~541 km), so the statement is false and 'Nepravda' is correct (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Geography_of_Slovakia).

explanation: Nepravda, najdlhšia je južná hranica s Maďarskom, ktorá má vyše 600 kilometrov. Veľkú časť z nej tvoria Dunaj a Ipeľ.

question: Najdlhšiu pozemnú hranicu nemá Francúzsko so Španielskom ani s Nemeckom, ale s krajinou na úplne inom kontinente. S ktorou?
source_excerpt: The France–Brazil border is the international border between French Guiana, an overseas department of France, and Brazil.

extra.why_interesting: Everyone pictures France's borders inside Europe, with Spain, Belgium or Germany. The answer lies on another continent, and the 'aha' comes once the player remembers French Guiana.
extra.verification_notes: France's longest land border is with Brazil (French Guiana, ~673–730 km), longer than Spain (~623 km) or Germany (~418 km); no later event changes this (checked from memory, not searched; see https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/France).

explanation: Vďaka Francúzskej Guyane v Južnej Amerike má Francúzsko s Brazíliou hranicu dlhú asi 730 kilometrov. Je to najdlhšia francúzska pozemná hranica.

question: Dunaj drží svetový rekord: preteká priamo viacerými hlavnými mestami ako ktorákoľvek iná rieka na svete. Koľkými?
source_excerpt: the Danube passes through four capital cities, more than any other river in the world

extra.why_interesting: Slovaks see the Danube in Bratislava every day but rarely think of it as a world record holder. Players can reason it out by mentally following the river downstream on a map from Germany to the Black Sea. Counting the capitals gives the 'I can work this out!' moment, and learning it is a world record gives the 'huh, really?' payoff.
extra.verification_notes: The Danube passes through four capitals (Vienna, Bratislava, Budapest, Belgrade), widely cited as the most of any river, though no source ranks rivers directly and none contradicts it.

explanation: Viedeň, Bratislava, Budapešť a Belehrad – všetky štyri ležia priamo na Dunaji a dve z nich, Viedeň a Bratislava, sú od seba len asi 55 kilometrov.
